grammar.summary: 本课学习表"武装"的 be armed with 与 so long as。

points.title: be armed with 表配备
points.explanation: Man is armed with knowledge. 武装到头脑：armed with + 工具的隐喻用法。

examples.en: We are armed with modern science.
examples.cn: 我们用现代科学武装起来。

points.title: so long as 表只要
points.explanation: So long as we survive, ... = as long as：条件复现，口语书面通用。

examples.en: So long as the species survives, there is hope.
examples.cn: 只要物种存续，就有希望。
